content.text: I’ve settled the responsibility split: CodeRabbit will review every branch target in a stack and only raise material correctness/security/reliability defects; its lint/static-analysis integrations will be disabled. DeepSource will remain bug/security-oriented with maximum complexity thresholds and no formatter/type-checker integration. CI will own the canonical project gate plus a scoped Python type check and a high-signal Semgrep security scan.
